CampaignAudience.title: Audience
CampaignAudience.subtitle: Membership is computed from your smart segments. Consent and suppression are applied before launch.
CampaignAudience.noAudienceHint: Add smart-segment conditions above, save, then estimate who qualifies.
CampaignAudience.estimateSubtitle: A point-in-time count of who would qualify right now.
CampaignAudience.consentHint: Missing granted marketing consent for the channel.
CampaignAudience.suppressedHint: On the suppression list (unsubscribe, bounce, complaint, or do-not-contact).
CampaignAudience.restrictedHint: Processing suspended or ceased for the contact.
CampaignAudience.onlyPersonNote: Consent and suppression only apply to contact audiences.
CampaignAudience.snapshotsSubtitle: Immutable records of who qualified, and why, at each freeze.

CampaignMessages.title: Messages
CampaignMessages.subtitle: Author the content each send delivers. Revisions are immutable once saved.

CampaignMessages.channelHint: Only email is available in this release.
CampaignMessages.selectHint: Select a message to author its content.

CampaignMessages.unsubscribeHint: '{{'unsubscribe_url'}}' is available and an unsubscribe link is appended automatically.

CampaignSends.title: Sends
CampaignSends.subtitle: Dispatch a message to a frozen audience snapshot. Queueing is the actual send.
